dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT / Micro Focus Visual COBOL with ACUCOBOL extensions; generated by TOTEM framework (Italian ERP/order management tool). Uses HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, HANDLE OF BITMAP, HANDLE OF STATUS-BAR, COMP-4, CRT STATUS, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA — all characteristic of ACUCOBOL-GT GUI dialect.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian order management / sales order processing system (fattura/ordini/clienti/articoli/agenti). Handles orders (tordini), order lines (rordini), clients, articles, agents, VAT codes, payment codes, warehouses, packaging (imballi), and invoice generation.
purpose.summary: A generated COBOL program (by the TOTEM framework) implementing a GUI-based sales order management form. It manages the full lifecycle of sales orders including customer, agent, article lines, VAT calculation, warehouse stock, and invoice/delivery note linkage. The program is part of an Italian ERP system with Italian-language field names and date formats.

notable_features: Generated by TOTEM framework (Italian COBOL GUI generator)
ACUCOBOL-GT GUI extensions: HANDLE OF WINDOW/FONT/BITMAP/STATUS-BAR
88-level condition names with WHEN SET TO FALSE
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based I/O only

The TOTEM generator comment and Italian locale (DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, Italian field names, date 'mercoledì 8 novembre 2023') confirm this is a production Italian ERP application. program_type set to online-cics as closest enum for interactive GUI program (no CICS, but ACUCOBOL GUI screen handling).
